title: VTG Genuine Porcelain Doll & Matching Miniature Ornament - Victorian Collection
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText:
1995 Vintage Genuine Porcelain Doll with a matching miniature ornament from the Victorian Collection by Brass Key. The set includes the doll and the ornament, both made of porcelain. It is a collectible item that would be a charming addition to any doll collection.

By Melissa Jane.

Includes Certificate of Authenticity & wooden display stand.

HANDCRAFTED IN CHINA
Recommended for ages over 8 years

Item# 76867
